excerpts.text:
set "MINGW_BIN=C:\MinGW\bin"
:mingw
if not exist "%MINGW_BIN%\g++.exe" (
    echo [build] FATAL: MinGW g++ not found at "%MINGW_BIN%\g++.exe".
    echo [build] MinGW is this project's PRIMARY oracle -- it is the only
    echo [build] toolchain that reproduces BCB6's x87 arithmetic. Do not
    echo [build] substitute another compiler here.
    exit /b 1
)
set "PATH=%MINGW_BIN%;%PATH%"

REM AI(W906-FASTBUILD) 20260921: locate ninja.exe and ccache.exe. Both are
REM   OPTIONAL accelerators (installed 20260921 with "winget install
REM   Ccache.Ccache" / "winget install Ninja-build.Ninja", user scope). winget
REM   adds them to the USER PATH, which a shell opened before the install does
REM   not see, so the winget package dirs are probed as a fallback. ccache is
REM   consumed by CMakeLists.txt (find_program); it only has to be reachable
REM   on PATH here. Neither is required: without them this is the old build.
set "WINGET_PKGS=%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages"
set "NINJA_EXE="
for %%P in (ninja.exe) do if exist "%%~$PATH:P" set "NINJA_EXE=%%~$PATH:P"
if not defined NINJA_EXE for /d %%D in ("%WINGET_PKGS%\Ninja-build.Ninja_*") do if exist "%%~D\ninja.exe" set "NINJA_EXE=%%~D\ninja.exe"
set "CCACHE_EXE="
for %%P in (ccache.exe) do if exist "%%~$PATH:P" set "CCACHE_EXE=%%~$PATH:P"
if not defined CCACHE_EXE for /d %%D in ("%WINGET_PKGS%\Ccache.Ccache_*") do for /d %%E in ("%%~D\ccache-*") do if exist "%%~E\ccache.exe" set "CCACHE_EXE=%%~E\ccache.exe"
if defined CCACHE_EXE for %%F in ("%CCACHE_EXE%") do set "PATH=%%~dpF;%PATH%"

REM Generator: Ninja when available (faster dependency scan, better -j
REM   scheduling on 697 objects), else the historical MinGW Makefiles. Only the
REM   FIRST configure of a dir uses this; re-configures inherit from the cache.
set "GEN=MinGW Makefiles"

set(HT9045_CXX_STANDARD 17 CACHE STRING "C++ standard. 17 = oracle/default. 14 ONLY for the WinLibs g++ 16 lanes (std::byte vs w32api byte clash, cmydef.h:127)")  # AI(W906-IOWEB-P1) 20260924: ported from the field tree (AI(W906-MachineImport) 20260825); build_nonoracle.bat/build_x64.bat already pass -DHT9045_CXX_STANDARD=14, which this file silently ignored. Default 17 => build.bat (6.3.0) unchanged. On the old blank line so no line below moves.
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD ${HT9045_CXX_STANDARD})
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
